scientific_integrity: Computational enumeration exhaustive for the exact finite domain; two independent H1 trace methods agree; novelty scoped to residual character, not the previously published fixed-space homotopy.
scientific_limitations: Finite six-label residual symmetry theorem; rational irreducible decomposition only; integral module specified concretely as graph-cycle kernel; no generalized normalizer classification. Relevant fixed-space homotopy classification is previous work, not new.
title: The complete residual \(S_4\)-character of an involution-fixed directed-forest circle bouquet
